_comment: ROBACHA deployment record for Robinhood Chain mainnet. Every address below was confirmed to hold bytecode via eth_getCode, and byte length was matched against the compiled artifact. Verify.s.sol passed against these addresses.

admin.note: Funded and active. NOTE: this address is also the deployer, so no deployer/admin privilege separation exists — one EOA holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on every contract. TransferRoles cannot reduce this.

deployer.note: Same address as admin. See admin.note.

contracts._autoBuyerNote: Redeployed against a Uniswap V2 router after the original V3 router address was found not to implement exactInputSingle. Verified on chain: router WETH() matches the contract constant, swapExactETHForTokens is present, and a full swapAndFund call simulates successfully end to end.

ethereum.note: Shares an address with the Robinhood reward vault. This is expected, not an error: a CREATE address is derived from (deployer, nonce), and the same deployer used the same nonce on both chains.

measuredDeploymentGas._comment: Measured by executing script/DeployRobinhood.s.sol against an anvil fork of Robinhood Chain mainnet on 2026-07-26. Real bytecode, real CCIP router address, real chain state.

randomness.architecture: RobachaGacha -> RobachaRandomnessSender -> Chainlink CCIP -> EthereumRobachaRandomnessCoordinator -> Chainlink VRF v2.5 -> CCIP -> RobachaRandomnessReceiver -> RobachaGacha
randomness.note: No manual, operator-supplied or block-derived randomness source exists anywhere in src/. The previous ManualRandomness adapter has been deleted. If this architecture is not fully configured and funded, spinReadiness returns false and paid spins stay closed.

inventory.note: Acquired through RobachaAutoBuyer and deposited via vault.fund().

pool.name: Genesis Pool
pool.note: Active and solvent; spinReadiness reports ready. Paid spins remain closed because PUBLIC_PAID_SPINS_ENABLED is false. OPEN ISSUE: the surcharge of 0.0001 ETH per entry sits below the measured CCIP cost of ~0.000666 ETH per round, so a round needs ~7 entries to cover its own randomness. The surcharge becomes immutable on the first paid spin (lockedAt is still 0).

verification.blockscoutNote: All 7 Robinhood contracts verified and source-matched on Blockscout.

testing.forkDeploymentRehearsal: script/DeployRobinhood.s.sol executed successfully against an anvil fork of chain 4663
